description: Configuration file for the Xenomorph toolchain.

ast.description: Print the parsed AST for each module.

tokens.description: Print the token stream for each module.

entry.description: Entry module path relative to the workspace root, without the `.xen` extension.

builder.description: Annotate every generated class with Lombok's `@Builder`.

data.description: Annotate every generated class with Lombok's `@Data`.

output.description: Target directory for generated .java files, relative to the workspace root. Package sub-directories are created inside it. If omitted, files are written next to their .xen sources.

package.description: Java package the generated DTOs belong to, e.g. `com.xyz.model`.

value.description: Annotate every generated class with Lombok's `@Value` (immutable DTOs).

output.description: Output directory for generated .schema.json files, relative to the workspace root. If omitted, files are written next to their .xen sources.

path.description: Directory containing the compiled plugin libraries, relative to the workspace root.

plugins.description: Plugin library names to load (without the platform-specific `lib` prefix or file extension).

output.description: Output directory for generated .ts files, relative to the workspace root. If omitted, files are written next to their .xen sources.

workdir.description: Workspace root override. Normally detected automatically from the location of `xenomorph.toml`.

title: Xenomorph configuration (xenomorph.toml)
